title: Cad Transformation Verb Transfer
description: Rename transformation verb from transform to transfer everywhere in cad (ModelSpace.transfer, UI labels, play toolbar ids/categories, tests). Keep geometric edit actions transform.move etc. and noun Transformation types.
summary: Renamed model-definition transformation verb from transform to transfer across cad: ModelSpace.transfer(), play/renderer UI (Transfer from/to, status messages), CadPlayToolbarState transfersTo/transfersFrom, cad.play.transfer.* tool ids, and AppToolCategory transfer in framework (replacing transform). Geometric edit actions (transform.move, etc.) and Transformation noun types unchanged. All @cad/js/core (342), @cad/js/renderer (51), and @framework/core (18) tests pass.
